summary: Barnstable County tower run by the Massachusetts Bureau of Forest Fire Control; 70 ft steel tower built 1947 to replace a 1913 tower; staffed and active at a 2006 visit.

facts.design: 70-foot steel tower with a standard 10 by 10 foot wooden cab
facts.status_note: The only visit report read is dated September 10, 2006 and calls the tower active; no newer condition report found
facts.agency: Massachusetts Bureau of Forest Fire Control

access.note: Active state fire tower run by the Bureau; the sources read describe no public visiting route or climbing arrangement

events.note: Registered June 30, 2004; nominated by Henry Isenberg
Register visit report dated September 10, 2006 records the tower as staffed and still active

notes_for_editor: The Forest Fire Lookout Association Facebook post on this tower returned only a login wall, so its search-snippet claim that the cab was replaced in 1967 is not used. The Section 15 text read shows no publication date and describes this tower only by location. The only visit report on file is from 2006, so present condition and access are unverified. Build history rests on one register entry. No photos recorded.
